items.title: Stock Market News for Aug 17, 2026
items.summary: Wall Street closed lower on Friday, dragged down by health and tech stocks.

items.title: KLA Corporation Had a Tough Month: 60% Returns Will Come According to This Wall Street Stalwart
items.summary: Wall Street's most dominant process control chipmaker just dropped nearly 10% in a month despite a five-quarter beat streak, and one high-conviction analyst sees a gap forming that the rest of the Street has not yet priced in.

items.title: S&P 500 nears record as weak retail data and Iran tensions shape critical week
items.summary: The S&P 500 enters a pivotal week for earnings and economic data within touching distance of a record close, after finishing Friday, August 14, just 13 points below its all-time closing high of 7,798. 99.

items.title: Applied Materials Trades More Than 25% Below Its High With Revenue at a Record
items.summary: The equipment maker just posted records on nearly every line and guided even higher. The stock is priced as if it won't last.

items.title: AMAT Q2 Deep Dive: AI Demand and Advanced Packaging Drive Guidance Upside, Market Reacts Cautiously
items.summary: Semiconductor machinery manufacturer Applied Materials (NASDAQ:AMAT) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 24.8% year on year to $9.12 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($10.25 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 6.1% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.50 per share was 3.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Applied Materials Beat Everything but Wall Street’s Expectations for Margins
items.summary: Applied Materials beat Q3 estimates and raised guidance, but shares fell 6% as sequential growth slowed and gross margin guidance stalled at 50.4% for Q4.

items.title: Applied Materials (AMAT) Stock: A Top AI Pick After Record Q3 Results
items.summary: Applied Materials' record Q3 results demonstrated that the company is translating the AI infrastructure boom into higher revenue, profits, and cash flow.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Aug. 14: Rally Stalls on Disappointing Consumer Data, Broadcom Falls 6%
items.summary: On Aug. 14, 2026, disappointing retail spending and consumer confidence data pulled markets back from record highs, with chipmakers leading declines.
